title: PizzaMod-Food
description: Adds a craftable pizza item that gives you a Speed boost when eaten
body:
🍕 PizzaMod - Add Delicious Pizza to Minecraft!

Ever wanted to enjoy a slice of pizza in Minecraft? Now you can!

✨ Features

- Craftable Pizza Item - Craft your own pizza using simple ingredients
- Speed Boost Effect - Eating pizza gives you Speed II for 30 seconds
- Vanilla-Friendly - Works perfectly in survival mode

📜 Crafting Recipe

To craft pizza you'll need:
- 6 Bread
- 2 Eggs
- 1 Milk Bucket

Arrange them in a crafting table with bread on the top and bottom rows and eggs + milk in the middle!

 -Btw My First Mod

 📦 Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader
2. Download this mod
3. Place the .jar file in your mods folder
4. Enjoy your pizza!
